usage: As a noun, '打拳' refers to the sport or practice of boxing.
As a verb, '打拳' means to do boxing or practice punching techniques.
It can be used in simple present tense to talk about a habitual action: 'I do boxing every morning.'
You can use it in past tense by adding time expressions, for example, 'I boxed yesterday evening.'
It is often used in casual conversation when talking about sports or fitness activities.
